sections.text: Radovi u ovoj fazi podrazumevaju potpuno zauzeće kolovoza desne kolovozne trake u Bulevaru umetnosti na datom potezu pri čemu će raskrsnica sa Bulevarom Zorana Đinđića biti prohodna. title: Informacija o promeni režima rada linije br. 3A tokom izvođenja radova u ulici Bulevar vojvode Mišića

sections.text: Tokom izvođenja radova u ulici Bulevar Vojvode Mišića u zoni Mosta na Adi, a u funkciji radova na izgradnji Bulevara Patrijarha Pavla - Etapa 1, u periodu od 22.06. do 01.09.2026. godine, doći će do promena u radu linije javnog prevoza br. 3A.

text_translations.en: During the execution of works on Bulevar Vojvode Mišića in the area of ​​Mosta na Ada, and in the function of works on the construction of Bulevar Patrijarh Pavla - Stage 1, in the period from 22.06. until 01.09.2026. year, there will be changes in the operation of public transport line no. 3A.

sections.text: Radovi se izvode na kolovozu u ulici Bulevar vojvode Mišića, na delu od pozicije koja se nalazi oko 230 metara ispred ukrštaja sa tramvajskim šinama, sledećih 190 metara gledano u smeru ka Topčiderskom parku. Tokom izvođenja radova doći će do zauzeća desne kolovozne trake, gledano u smeru ka Topčiderskom parku, pri čemu će leva kolozna traka na deonici gde je zona radova biti dvosmerna za saobraćaj. Takođe, biće onemogućen pristup iz saobraćajnice koja se nalazi ispod nadvožnjaka Mosta na Adi ka saobraćajnici koja vodi prema ulici Teodora Drajzera, zbog čega će vozila sa linije br. 3A u smeru ka Kneževcu saobraćati ulicama Bulevar vojvode Mišića, ulaznom rampom ka velikom kružnom toku u nivou Mosta na Adi, zatim ponovo Bulevarom vojvode Mišića. U visini zone radova  vozila će preći u levu kolovoznu traku koja je dvosmerna za saobraćaj, a nakon približno 100 metara vratiće se u desnu kolovoznu traku u Bulevar vojvode Mišića i dalje nastaviti redovnom trasom ka Kneževcu, dok će u suprotnom smeru saobraćati redovnom trasom.

text_translations.en: The works are being carried out on the carriageway in Bulevar Vojvode Mišića Street, on the part from the position located about 230 meters in front of the intersection with the tram tracks, the next 190 meters in the direction of Topčiderski Park. During the execution of the works, the right carriageway will be occupied, seen in the direction of Topčiderski Park, while the left carriageway on the section where the work zone is will be two-way for traffic. Also, it will be impossible to access from the road that is located under the overpass of Mosta na Ada to the road that leads to Teodora Dreizer Street, which is why vehicles from line no. 3A in the direction of Kneževac, drive along Vojvode Mišić Boulevard, take the entrance ramp to the large roundabout at the level of the Bridge on Ada, then again on Vojvode Mišić Boulevard. At the height of the work zone, vehicles will move to the left lane, which is two-way for traffic, and after approximately 100 meters, they will return to the right lane in Vojvode Mišić Boulevard and continue on the regular route towards Kneževac, while they will drive in the opposite direction on the regular route.

sections.text: Za vreme trajanja ove režimske izmene neće funkcionisati stajalište „Careva ćuprija“ u smeru ka Kneževcu.

text_translations.en: During the duration of this regime change, the "Careva ćuprija" stop in the direction of Kneževac will not function.

title_translations.en: Information on the change of mode of operation of line no. 3A during the execution of works in Bulevar Vojvode Mišić Street

text_translations.en: During the performance of regular maintenance works in Gospodara Vučića Street (Zvezdara) in the period from 13.06. until 3.7.2026. there will be changes in the operation of public transport lines.

sections.text: Radovi se izvode na kolovozu i na trotoaru u ulici Gospodara Vučića, na delu od ulice Slobodanke Danke Savić do ulice Ravaničke. text_translations.en: The works are being carried out on the roadway and on the sidewalk in Gospodara Vučića Street, on the part from Slobodanka Danka Savić Street to Ravanička Street. During the execution of works on the section in question, the right traffic lane will be closed (viewed in the direction of Vojislav Ilića Street), and public transport lines will run as follows:

text_translations.en: Vehicles from line no. 55 in the direction of Zvezdara will travel through the streets: Gospodar Vučić, Vjekoslav Kovač until the "Zvezdara /pijaca/" roundabout, while in the opposite direction it will travel from the "Zvezdara /piaca/" roundabout through the streets of Vjekoslav Kovač, Deskašev, Bulevar Kralja Aleksnadr, Ustanička, Vojislav Ilić, Gospodar Vučić and further along the regular route.

text_translations.en: Public transport vehicles will use all existing JLPP stops on the modified section of the route.

sections.text: Tokom izvođenja nove faze radova na uklanjanju Starog savskog mosta i izgradnji novog mosta u ulici Zemunski put, na delu od zone raskrsnice sa Vladimira Popovića do zone raskrsnice sa ulicama Zarije Vujuoševića i Sajmište u periodu od 09.06. 2026 godine do 02.09.2027. godine, doći će do promena u radu linija javnog prevoza. text_translations.en: The Secretariat for Public Transport informs the public that, starting Tuesday, April 21, 2026, preparatory works will begin on part of the tunnel connection from Karađorđeva Street to Dunavska Padina - Phase 1.

sections.text: Tokom navedene faze radova koja obuhvata ulicu Jovana Avakumovića (deo od ulice Bulevar despota Stefana u dužini od 110 metara prema ulici Poenkareova) i Bulevar despota Stefana (deo od ulice Dragoslava Srejovića u dužini od 450 metara do ul. Kralja Dragutina), predviđena su sledeća zauzeća i izmene:

text_translations.en: During the mentioned phase of the works, which includes Jovana Avakumovića Street (part from Bulevar Despota Stefana in a length of 110 meters towards Poenkareova Street) and Bulevar Despota Stefana (a part from Dragoslav Srejovića Street in a length of 450 meters to Kralja Dragutin Street), the following occupations and changes are planned:

text_translations.en: During regular maintenance works on Vojvode Micka Krstić Street (Palilula), on the part from the intersection with Višnjička Street to the intersection with Patrisa Lumumba Street. The works will be carried out in the period from 26.5. until 5.7.2026. there will be changes in the operation of public transport lines.

title: Informacija o promeni režima rada linija javnog prevoza tokom izvođenja radova u ulici Vojvode Stepa Stepanović

sections.text: Tokom izvođenja radova na asfaltiranju i uređenju ulice Vojvode Stepe Stepanovića (Beograd - Kaluđerica), na delu od kućnog broja 25 do zone raskrsnice sa ulicom Ive Lole Ribara, doći će do promena u radu linija javnog prevoza.

text_translations.en: During the execution of asphalting and landscaping works on Vojvoda Stepa Stepanović Street (Belgrade - Kaluđerica), in the section from house number 25 to the area of ​​the intersection with Ive Lola Ribara Street, there will be changes in the operation of public transport lines.

sections.text: Radovi će se izvoditi po fazama i to:

text_translations.en: The works will be carried out in phases, namely:

sections.text: Faza 1.1. - Radovi se izvode na kolovozu (leva saobraćajna traka) u ulici Vojvode Stepe Stepanovića, na delu od kućnog broja 25, sledećih 125 gledano u smeru ka ulici Ive Lole Ribara. Tokom izvođenja radova vozila JLPP-a br. 309, 313, 304N i 307N će se u zoni radova kretati slobodnom desnom saobraćajnom trakom širine najmanje 3,5 metara uz naizmenično propuštanje regulisano privremenim semaforima. Radovi će se izvoditi u periodu 28.5. do 8.6.2026. godine.

text_translations.en: Phase 1.1. - The works are being carried out on the roadway (left traffic lane) in Vojvode Stepa Stepanovića Street, on the part of house number 25, the next 125 viewed in the direction of Ive Lola Ribara Street. During the execution of works of JLPP vehicle no. 309, 313, 304N and 307N will move in the work zone in the free right traffic lane with a width of at least 3.5 meters with alternating passing regulated by temporary traffic lights. The works will be performed in the period 28.5. until June 8, 2026. year.

sections.text: Faza 1.8. - Radovi se izvode na kolovozu (desna saobraćajna traka) u ulici Vojvode Stepe Stepanovića, na delu od kućnog broja 25, sledećih 125 gledano u smeru ka ulici Ive Lole Ribara. Tokom izvođenja radova vozila JLPP-a br. 309, 313, 304N i 307N će se u zoni radova kretati slobodnom levom saobraćajnom trakom širine najmanje 3,5 metara uz naizmenično propuštanje regulisano privremenim semaforima. Radovi će se izvoditi u periodu 9.6. do 21.6.2026. godine.

text_translations.en: Phase 1.8. - The works are being carried out on the roadway (right traffic lane) in Vojvode Stepa Stepanovića Street, on the part of house number 25, the next 125 viewed in the direction of Ive Lola Ribara Street. During the execution of works of JLPP vehicle no. 309, 313, 304N and 307N will move in the work zone in the free left traffic lane with a width of at least 3.5 meters with alternating passing regulated by temporary traffic lights. The works will be carried out in the period 9.6. until 21.6.2026. year.

sections.text: Tokom izvođenja radova u fazama 1.1 i 1.8, privremeno se ukida linija 309L, a uspostavlja se minibus linija br. 309L1, koja će u oba smera saobraćati redovnom trasom linije br. 309L do ulice Vojvode Stepe Stepanovića, dalje ulicom Đure Đakovića do privremene okretnice „Kaluđerica /Ribnička/“.

text_translations.en: During the execution of works in phases 1.1 and 1.8, line 309L is temporarily suspended, and minibus line no. 309L1, which will run in both directions on the regular route of line no. 309L to Vojvoda Stepa Stepanovića street, further along Đura Đakovića street to the temporary turnpike "Kaluđerica /Ribnička/".

title_translations.en: Information about the change in the mode of operation of public transport lines during the execution of works in Vojvode Stepa Stepanović Street

title: Informacija o radovima u ulici Vojvođanska - Faza 2

text_translations.en: During the execution of Phase 2 of works on the asphalting and landscaping of Vojvođanska Street (GO Surčin), on the part from Aerodrom Beograd Street to Hajduk Veljkova Street, in the period from 15.6. until 5.7.2026. there will be changes in the functioning of public transport.

sections.text: Radovi podrazumevaju zauzeće krajnje desne saobraćajne trake (gledano u smeru ka gradu) i trotoara na predmetnoj deonici pri čemu će se vozila JLPP-a u zoni radova kretati slobodnom širinom kolovoza koja će biti dvosmerna za saobraćaj.

text_translations.en: The works involve the occupation of the far right traffic lane (seen in the direction of the city) and the sidewalk on the section in question, whereby JLPP vehicles in the work zone will move on the free width of the roadway, which will be two-way for traffic.

sections.text: Prilikom izvođenja radova u ovoj fazi, privremeno se izmeštaju autobuska stajališta i to:

text_translations.en: During the execution of the works in this phase, the bus stops are temporarily moved, namely:

text_translations.en: - "Weekend naselje" (direction to Surčin) - the stop returns to its regular position;

sections.text: - „Vikend naselje“ (smer ka gradu) - stajalište će i dalje biti na privremenoj poziciji koja se nalazi oko 30 metara posle zone raskrnice sa ulicom Moma Kapora, odnosno oko 70 metara posle (unapred) redovne pozicije (kao u fazi 1).

text_translations.en: - "Weekend naselje" (direction towards the city) - the stop will still be at a temporary position located about 30 meters after the intersection zone with Moma Kapora street, i.e. about 70 meters after the (advance) regular position (as in phase 1).

title: Informacija o promeni režima rada linija javnog prevoza tokom izvođenja radova u ulici Crnotravska

sections.text: Tokom izvođenja radova na rekonstrukciji distributivne toplovodne mreže u ulici Crnotravska doći će do promena u radu linija javnog prevoza. Radovi će se izvoditi po fazama i to:

text_translations.en: During the works on the reconstruction of the distribution hot water network in Crnotravska Street, there will be changes in the operation of public transport lines. The works will be carried out in phases, namely:

sections.text: Faza 2 - radovi se nadovezuju na posjeće radove i izvode se narednih 80 metara gledano u smeru ka gradu u periodu od 1.6. do 12.6.2026. godine. Tokom izvođenja radova biće zauzeta desna strana trotoara (gledano u smeru ka gradu), pri čemu ovi radovi neće uticati na funkcionisanje JLPP-a;

text_translations.en: Phase 2 - the works follow up on the existing works and are carried out for the next 80 meters in the direction of the city in the period from 1.6. until 12.6.2026. year. During the execution of the works, the right side of the sidewalk (seen in the direction of the city) will be occupied, and these works will not affect the functioning of the JLPP;

sections.text: Faza 3 - radovi se nadovezuju na radove iz faze 2, sledećih 150 metara gledano u smeru ka gradu u periodu od 13.6. do 2.7.2026. godine. Tokom izvođenja radova biće zauzeta desna kolovozna traka (gledano u smeru ka gradu), pri čemu će se vozila JLPP-a u zoni radova kretati preostalom širinom kolovoza koja će biti dvosmerna za saobraćaj. Prilikom izvođenja radova privremeno se izmeštaju autobuska stajališta „Vojnomedicinska akademija“ i to:

text_translations.en: Phase 3 - the works are a continuation of the works from phase 2, the next 150 meters seen in the direction of the city in the period from 13.6. until 2.7.2026. year. During the execution of the works, the right lane will be occupied (looking towards the city), whereby JLPP vehicles in the work zone will move on the remaining width of the roadway, which will be two-way for traffic. During the execution of the works, the "Military Medical Academy" bus stops are temporarily relocated, namely:

sections.text:
• smer ka gradu, izmešta se na lokaciju koja se nalazi oko 55 metra posle redovne pozicije;
• smer ka Banjici, izmešta se na lokaciju koja se nalazi oko 195 metara ispred redovne pozicije;

text_translations.en:
• direction towards the city, it is moved to a location located about 55 meters after the regular position;
• the direction towards Banjica, is moved to a location located about 195 meters in front of the regular position;

sections.text: Faza 4 - radovi se nadovezuju na radove iz faze 3, sledećih 200 metara gledano u smeru ka gradu u periodu od 3.7. do 27.7.2026. godine. Tokom izvođenja radova biće zauzeta desna kolovozna traka (gledano u smeru ka gradu), pri čemu će se vozila JLPP-a u zoni radova kretati preostalom širinom kolovoza koja će biti dvosmerna za saobraćaj;

text_translations.en: Phase 4 - the works follow up on the works from phase 3, the next 200 meters seen in the direction of the city in the period from 3.7. until 27.7.2026. year. During the execution of the works, the right lane will be occupied (looking towards the city), whereby JLPP vehicles in the work zone will move on the remaining width of the roadway, which will be two-way for traffic;

sections.text: Tokom izvođenja radova u navedenim fazama, trolejbuska linija br. 40 će saobraćati na skraćenoj trasi do stare okretnice „Banjica“.

text_translations.en: During the execution of works in the mentioned phases, trolleybus line no. 40 will run on a shortened route to the old "Banjica" turnpike.

title: Informacija o promeni režima rada linija javnog prevoza tokom izvođenja radova u ulici Banatska

sections.text: Tokom izvođenja radova na instalaciji fekalne kanalizacije u ulici Banatska (Zemun) doći će do promena u radu linija javnog prevoza. Radovi će se izvoditi po fazama i to:

text_translations.en: During the execution of works on the installation of fecal sewage in Banatska Street (Zemun), there will be changes in the operation of public transport lines. The works will be carried out in phases, namely:

sections.text: Faza 4 - radovi u ovoj fazi podrazumevaju potpuno zatvaranje za saobraćaj ulice Banatska na delu od zone raskrsnice sa ulicom Somborska (uključujući i samu raskrsnicu) do zone raskrsnice  sa ulicom Ugrinovačka. Radovi u ovoj fazi će se izvoditi u periodu od 07.05. do 27.05.2026. godine.

text_translations.en: Phase 4 - works in this phase involve the complete closure of Banatska Street to traffic in the part from the intersection zone with Somborska Street (including the intersection itself) to the intersection zone with Ugrinovačka Street. Works in this phase will be carried out in the period from 07.05. until 27.05.2026. year.

sections.text: Faza 4a - radovi u ovoj fazi podrazumevaju potpuno zatvaranje za saobraćaj ulice Banatska na delu od zone raskrsnice sa ulicom Somborska (slobodna raskrsnica) do zone raskrsnice  sa ulicom Ugrinovačka. Radovi u ovoj fazi će se izvoditi u periodu od 28.05. do 12.06.2026. godine.

text_translations.en: Phase 4a - works in this phase involve the complete closure of Banatska Street to traffic on the part from the intersection zone with Somborska Street (free intersection) to the intersection zone with Ugrinovačka Street. Works in this phase will be carried out in the period from 28.05. until 12.06.2026. year.

sections.text: Faza 3 - radovi u ovoj fazi podrazumevaju potpuno zatvaranje za saobraćaj ulice Banatska na delu od zone raskrsnice sa ulicom Niška do zone raskrsnice  sa ulicom Somborska. Radovi u ovoj fazi će se izvoditi u periodu od 13.06. do 15.07.2026. godine.

text_translations.en: Phase 3 - works in this phase involve the complete closure of Banatska Street for traffic in the part from the intersection zone with Niška Street to the intersection zone with Somborska Street. Works in this phase will be carried out in the period from 13.06. until 15.07.2026. year.

sections.text: Faza 2a - radovi u ovoj fazi podrazumevaju potpuno zatvaranje za saobraćaj ulice Banatska na delu od zone raskrsnice sa ulicom Cara Dušana do zone raskrsnice  sa ulicom Niška (uključujući i samu raskrsnicu). Radovi u ovoj fazi će se izvoditi u periodu od 16.07. do 05.08.2026. godine.

text_translations.en: Phase 2a - works in this phase involve the complete closure of Banatska Street to traffic in the part from the intersection zone with Cara Dušana Street to the intersection zone with Niška Street (including the intersection itself). Works in this phase will be carried out in the period from 16.07. until 05.08.2026. year.

sections.text: Faza 2 - radovi u ovoj fazi podrazumevaju potpuno zatvaranje za saobraćaj ulice Banatska na delu od zone raskrsnice sa ulicom Cara Dušana do zone raskrsnice  sa ulicom Niška (slobodna raskrsnica). Radovi u ovoj fazi će se izvoditi u periodu od 06.08. do 01.09.2026. godine.

text_translations.en: Phase 2 - works in this phase involve the complete closure of Banatska Street to traffic in the part from the intersection zone with Cara Dušana Street to the intersection zone with Niška Street (free intersection). Works in this phase will be carried out in the period from 06.08. until 01.09.2026. year.

sections.text: Tokom izvođenja radova u svim fazama vozila javnog prevoza će saobraćati na sledeći način:

text_translations.en: During the execution of works in all phases, public transport vehicles will operate as follows:

sections.text: Linija br. 85 će u smeru ka Banovom brdu saobraćati ulicama Cara Dušana, Filipa Višnjića, Ugrinovačka i dalje redovno, dok će u smeru ka Borči saobraćati ulicama Ugrinovačka, Autoput za Novi Sad, Spoljna magistralna tangenta, Pupinov most i dalje redovnom trasom;

text_translations.en: Line no. 85 in the direction of Banovo brdo will continue to travel through the streets of Cara Dušan, Filip Višnjić, Ugrinovačka and continue regularly, while in the direction of Borča it will continue through the streets of Ugrinovačka, Autoput za Novi Sad, Spojna magistralna tangenta, Pupinov most and continue along the regular route;

sections.text: Linije br. 103, 105L i 112 će u smeru ka terminusu „Zemun (Bačka)“ saobraćati ulicama Cara Dušana, Filipa Višnjića, Ugrinovačka, Bačka do termunusa „Zemun (Bačka)“, dok će u smeru ka Borči i Ovči saobraćati od terminusa „Zemun (Bačka)“ ulicama  Bačka, Ugrinovačka, Autoput za Novi Sad, Spoljna magistralna tangenta, Pupinov most i dalje redovnim trasama;

text_translations.en: Line no. 103, 105L and 112 in the direction of the terminus "Zemun (Bačka)" will travel along the streets of Cara Dušan, Filip Višnjić, Ugrinovačka, Bačka to the terminus "Zemun (Bačka)", while in the direction of Borča and Ovča they will travel from the terminus "Zemun (Bačka)" through the streets Bačka, Ugrinovačka, Autoput za Novi Sad, External main tangent, Pupinov bridge and still regular routes;

sections.text: Linija br. 612 će u smeru ka Novom Beogradu saobraćati ulicama Cara Dušana, Filipa Višnjića, Rada Končara i dalje redovno dok će u smeru ka Novoj Galenici saobraćati ulicama Ugrinovačka, Autoput za Novi Sad, Spoljna magistralna tangenta, Cara Dušana i dalje redovnom trasom.

text_translations.en: Line no. 612 in the direction of New Belgrade will continue to run on the streets of Car Dušan, Filip Višnjić, Rad Končar, while in the direction of Nova Galenica it will continue to run on the streets of Ugrinovačka, Autoput za Novi Sad, Spojna magistralna tangenta, Car Dušan and on the regular route.

title: Informacija o promeni režima saobraćaja i režima rada linija javnog prevoza tokom izvođenja radova na uklanjanju Starog savskog mosta

sections.text:
• Tramvajske linije br. 7 i 9 će u oba smera, od zone Savskog trga saobraćati ulicama Savska, Bulevar vojvode Mišića, Petlja "Radnička", Most na Adi, Bulevar heroja sa Košara, Bulevar Crvene Armije, Bulevar Milutina Milankovića, Antifašističke borbe i dalje redovno do Bloka 45 i nosiće oznake 7L i 9L.
• Uspostavlja se privremena autobuska linija br. 9A (Trg Slavija - Blok 45)  koja će u intervalu od 12  minuta pokrivati deo trase kojim neće ići tramvaji (Bulevar Milutina Milankovića, Milentija Popovića i Sajmište) i trasa linije 9A biće: Trg Slavija, Nemanjina, Balkanska, Gavrila Principa, Pop Lukina, Brankov most, privremena devijacija na ulicu Ušće, Ušće (Bulevar Mihajla Pupina u smeru ka gradu), Sajmište, Zemunski put, tramvajskom bašticom do ulice Milentija Popovića i dalje redovno trasama tramvajskih linija do Bloka 45. 
• Autobuske linije br. 78 i 83 su počev od 04. oktobra zbog izvođenja pripremnih radova i oštećenja na Starom savskom mostu preusmerene na trasu Brankovim mostom i saobraćaju ulicama: Nemanjina, Balkanska, Gavrila Principa (Admirala Geprata u smeru ka Banjici odnosno Crvenom krstu), Pop Lukina, Brankov most, Bulevar Mihajla Pupina i dalje redovno do Zemuna. 
• Vozila će na izmenjenim delovima trasa koristiti postojeća kao i novouspostavljena privremena stajališta „Kamenička 1“ i „Brankov most 1“ za linije br. 9A, 78 i 83 - smer prema Trgu Slavija, odnosno „Staro sajmište“ - smer prema Bloku 45 za liniju br. 9A.

text_translations.en:
• Tram lines no. 7 and 9 will run in both directions, from the area of ​​Sava Square, through the streets of Savska, Bulevar Vojvode Mišić, Petlja "Radnička", Most na Ada, Bulevar Herojas sa Košar, Bulevar Crvena Armija, Bulevar Milutin Milankovića, Bulevar Antifascistke Borbe and continue regularly to Block 45 and will carry signs 7L and 9L.
• A temporary bus line no. 9A (Trg Slavija - Block 45), which will cover the part of the route on which trams will not run (Milutin Milanković Boulevard, Milentija Popovića and Sajmište) and the route of line 9A will be: Slavija Square, Nemanjina, Balkanska, Gavrila Principa, Pop Lukina, Brankov Most, temporary deviation to Ušće Street, Ušće (Mihajla Pupina Boulevard in the direction of the city), Sajmište, Zemunski put, by tram garden to Milentija Popovića Street and further by regular tram routes to Block 45. 
• Autobuske linije br. 78 and 83 have been diverted since October 4 due to preparatory works and damage to the Old Sava Bridge to the Brankov Most route and traffic on the streets: Nemanjina, Balkanska, Gavrilo Principa (Admiral Geprato in the direction of Banjica, i.e. the Red Cross), Pop Lukina, Brankov Most, Mihajla Pupina Boulevard and further regularly to Zemun. 
• Vehicles will use the existing as well as the newly established temporary stops "Kamenička 1" and "Brankov most 1" for lines no. 9A, 78 and 83 - direction towards Trg Slavija, i.e. "Staro sajmište" - direction towards Block 45 for line no. 9A.

title: Informacija o promeni režima rada linija javnog prevoza tokom izvođenja radova u ulicama Svetog Joakima i Ane u naselju Međulužje (GO Mladenovac)

sections.text: Tokom izvođenja radova na redovnom održavanju  ulice Svetog Joakima i Ane u naselju Međulužje (GO Mladenovac), na delu između kućnih brojeva 61 i 69, doći će do promena u radu linija br. 4192 i 4192A. Radovi će se izvoditi u periodu od 07.06.2024. do 31.12.2026. godine i isti podrazumevaju potpuno zatvaranje predmetne deonice, zbog čega će vozila sa linija br. 4192 i 4192A saobraćati ulicama Vojvode Vićentija, Balkanska, Stefana Nemanje, Paje Jovanovića, Vojvode Vićentija i dalje redovnim trasama.

text_translations.en: During the regular maintenance works on St. Joakim and Anna Street in Međulužje (GO Mladenovac), in the section between house numbers 61 and 69, there will be changes in the operation of line no. 4192 and 4192A. Radovi će se izvoditi u periodu od 07.06.2024. until 31.12.2026. year and the same implies the complete closure of the section in question, which is why vehicles from line no. 4192 and 4192A to drive through the streets of Vojvoda Vićenti, Balkanska, Stefan Nemanja, Paja Jovanović, Vojvoda Vićenti and further on regular routes.

title_translations.en: Information about the change in the mode of operation of public transport lines during the execution of works in the streets of Sveti Joakim and Ana in the Međulužje settlement (GO Mladenovac)

title: Informacija o promeni režima rada linija javnog prevoza br. 860U zbog oštećenja mosta iznad kanala u ulici gola bara u naselju Ušće - Opština Obrenovac

sections.text: Radovi su produženi do 31.07.2026. godine.

text_translations.en: The works have been extended until July 31, 2026. year.

sections.text: Na osnovu Rešenja Sekretarijata za saobraćaj o tehničkom regulisanju saobraćaja, a prema tehničkoj dokumentaciji ''Posebna organizacija saobraćaja u zoni mosta ID 364 preko kanala u ulici Gola Bara, MZ Ušće, opština Obrenovac'', izvršena je promena trasa  linija javnog prevoza br. 860U  u samom naselju Ušće zbog ograničenja kretanja vozila čija ukupna masa prelazi 3,5t.

text_translations.en: Based on the Decision of the Secretariat for Transport on the technical regulation of traffic, and according to the technical documentation "Special organization of traffic in the area of ​​the bridge ID 364 over the canal in Gola Bara street, MZ Ušće, Obrenovac municipality", the routes of public transport lines no. 860U in the Ušće settlement itself due to restrictions on the movement of vehicles whose total weight exceeds 3.5t.

sections.text: Tokom perioda trajanja ovog ograničenja, linije javnog prevoza br. 860U  će saobraćati na skraćenoj trasi do stare okretnice u naselju Ušće.

text_translations.en: During the duration of this restriction, public transport lines no. 860U will run on a shortened route to the old turnpike in the Ušće settlement.

sections.text: Na izmenjenom delu trase vozila će koristiti privremena stajališta u zonama istoimenih za suprotan smer.

text_translations.en: On the changed part of the route, vehicles will use temporary stops in the zones of the same name for the opposite direction.

title_translations.en: Information on the change of mode of operation of public transport lines no. 860U due to damage to the bridge above the canal in the street of Gola Bara in the settlement of Ušće - Municipality of Obrenovac
